text.en: Reviewers report noticeable progress with shelter dogs and energetic pets that previously pulled hard on leash. Clients emphasize that within four to six weeks of structured training, their dogs learn reliable obedience, walk calmly, and ignore distractions in public.

Handlers value the trainers' deep commitment to handler education, noting that staff follow through consistently on their commitments. Clients appreciate that trainers provide clear instruction and remain willing to reteach concepts whenever owners need assistance.

q.en: Does Stealth K9 offer board-and-train programs?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently enroll dogs in comprehensive four to six week training programs focused on obedience.

q.en: Are follow-up sessions provided after training ends?

a.en: Yes, reviewers highlight follow-up guidance and refresher support included to ensure lasting behavioral progress.

q.en: Can the program help dogs that pull heavily on leash?

a.en: Yes, handlers report successful behavior modification for shelter rescues and strong dogs that struggle with leash manners.
